notes: Round 2's finding is closed. The fix has one property worth keeping in mind: with the record guard gone, nothing checks that the name a call site passes is the name its client was connected with. Each of the three call sites holds that name in one variable used for both, so a mismatch cannot arise without an edit that breaks the pattern, and the empty-name refusal catches the common slip. I judged a check of the name against the capture to be exactly the asynchronous dependency this round removed.

Unchanged from round 1, for the reviewer: an overlap-refused update is sent again as the caller built it, so a concurrent write that does not satisfy this caller can be overwritten. That is the write a server without the race takes after the other update, and the loop re-sends only while the stream, read again, does not hold what the caller asked for.
